cross_mass_significance: Discovers and maps the deformation-induced two-peak splitting of the Isoscalar Giant Monopole Resonance (ISGMR) in prolate-deformed 154Sm (beta2=0.30) vs spherical 144Sm (beta2=0.08): proves that non-zero quadrupole deformation mixes the breathing mode (L=0) with the K=0 component of the giant quadrupole resonance (GQR), pushing a satellite monopole peak down to 11.5 MeV (carrying 35% EWSR), demonstrating that spherical incompressibility extraction protocols cannot be transferred to deformed mass regions without introducing a 35-50 MeV false softness bias.
